visual.title: The metric decides the ball
visual.caption: The Manhattan metric adds coordinate distances, so its ball is a diamond. Changing the metric changes which lattice points lie inside the same radius.

predict.question: Which points lie in the Manhattan ball of radius 2 around the origin?
options: Only points with x squared plus y squared at most 4
Points with absolute x plus absolute y at most 2
Every point in the square from -2 to 2
predict.explain: The Manhattan distance is the sum of the absolute coordinates, giving a diamond rather than a Euclidean disk.
